scope: Synthetic report rendering with a real compiler; no bridge analysis executed.

scenarios.name: 01_full_report
scenarios.purpose: Full nine-chapter demo with deliberately failed component checks.

scenarios.name: 02_minimal_data
scenarios.purpose: Only mandatory metadata; missing analysis remains explicitly unavailable.

scenarios.name: 03_one_girder
scenarios.purpose: Single-column girder summaries and individual member tables.

scenarios.name: 04_twelve_girders
scenarios.purpose: Wide executive summary plus long repeated member tables.

scenarios.name: 05_zero_girders
scenarios.purpose: Explicit zero girders produces unavailable rows without inventing members.

scenarios.name: 06_without_figures
scenarios.purpose: Text/tables render when figures are disabled.

scenarios.name: 07_without_toc
scenarios.purpose: Report numbering works when the table of contents is disabled.

scenarios.name: 08_loads_only
scenarios.purpose: Optional loads chapter without analysis or design chapters.

scenarios.name: 09_analysis_only
scenarios.purpose: Analysis chapter can be selected independently.

scenarios.name: 10_design_only
scenarios.purpose: Design tables/chart can be selected without optional loads and analysis.

scenarios.name: 11_core_sections_only
scenarios.purpose: Required intro/input/material/reference chapters without optional chapters.

scenarios.name: 12_all_vehicle_classes
scenarios.purpose: All eight standard UI vehicle selections render, including fatigue.

scenarios.name: 13_saved_false_flags
scenarios.purpose: Saved checkbox strings False/0 never select vehicles.

scenarios.name: 14_custom_vehicle_escaping
scenarios.purpose: Custom vehicle names include ampersand, percent, underscore and braces.

scenarios.name: 15_metadata_metacharacters
scenarios.purpose: Plain metadata escapes every LaTeX metacharacter safely.

scenarios.name: 16_unicode_engineering_text
scenarios.purpose: Accented Latin text and common engineering glyphs compile.

scenarios.name: 17_long_wrapped_metadata
scenarios.purpose: Long metadata wraps inside separate header columns.

scenarios.name: 18_automatic_footway
scenarios.purpose: Automatic footway mode reports the existing IRC helper value.

scenarios.name: 19_zero_custom_footway
scenarios.purpose: A valid custom zero is retained, rather than treated as missing.

scenarios.name: 20_no_footway
scenarios.purpose: Explicitly absent footway is distinct from missing pressure.

scenarios.name: 21_no_design_results
scenarios.purpose: Analysis-only backend output must not claim a passing design.

scenarios.name: 22_unity_threshold
scenarios.purpose: Ratios equal to one stay on the reference threshold.

scenarios.name: 23_exceeded_threshold
scenarios.purpose: Ratios above one are visibly reported as exceeding the limit.

scenarios.name: 24_zero_capacity
scenarios.purpose: A zero capacity never becomes a passing zero ratio.

scenarios.name: 25_nonfinite_result_fields
scenarios.purpose: Nonfinite demand/capacity inputs remain unavailable in summaries.

scenarios.name: 26_partial_deck_results
scenarios.purpose: Missing deck flags remain N/A; an explicit failed flag stays failed.

scenarios.name: 27_diaphragm_only
scenarios.purpose: Diaphragm data is independent when cross-bracing data is absent.

scenarios.name: 28_cross_bracing_only
scenarios.purpose: Missing diaphragm results cannot be copied from cross bracing.

scenarios.name: 29_missing_material_geometry
scenarios.purpose: Absent dimensions produce unavailable quantities, not invented tonnage.

scenarios.name: 30_large_material_scale
scenarios.purpose: Quantity chart scales large masses and keeps concrete/rebar units separate.

scenarios.name: 31_multipage_analysis
scenarios.purpose: 150 uniquely named loadcases survive repeated-header page breaks.

scenarios.name: 32_embedded_raster_figure
scenarios.purpose: Real in-memory PNG bytes survive the temporary assets lifecycle.

scenarios.name: 33_greek_temperature_symbols
scenarios.purpose: Greek engineering labels and Celsius symbols render with explicit TeX commands.

scenarios.name: 34_custom_vehicle_inclusion
scenarios.purpose: The actual custom-vehicle UI inclusion flag controls report selection.

scenarios.name: 35_supplied_diaphragm_quantity
scenarios.purpose: Explicitly supplied end-diaphragm tonnage is retained in the table and material chart.
